title: The 3 Best Panini Presses and Sandwich Makers for Grilled Cheese
h1: The 3 Best Panini Presses and Sandwich Makers for Grilled Cheese
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for panini presses and sandwich makers for grilled cheese, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at panini presses and sandwich makers for grilled cheese using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Hamilton Beach Panini Press 25460A
products.blurb: Key specs: Floating hinge opens 180 degrees, 8-inch by 10-inch nonstick grids, Ready indicator light.
strengths: Floating hinge presses evenly on thick or unevenly buttered bread without squeezing cheese out one side
8x10 grid fits two full sandwiches or a large single slice of Texas toast grilled cheese
Ready light removes the guesswork on when to add bread
limitations: No temperature dial, so timing matters more than on adjustable models
Grids aren't removable for a deep clean between uses
Larger footprint than a basic clamshell maker

products.name: Proctor Silex Deluxe Hot Sandwich Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: Fits 2 sandwiches at once, Ceramic nonstick plates, 700W element.
strengths: Ceramic nonstick plates release a melted-cheese sandwich cleanly
Fast preheat, ready for bread within a couple minutes
limitations: Fixed clamshell gap presses thick or stuffed sandwiches harder than a floating hinge
Smaller plate area than the Hamilton Beach or Cuisinart

products.name: Breville the Perfect Press Panini Press BSG600BSS
products.blurb: Key specs: Crush Control auto-pressure hinge, Adjustable temperature dial, Nonstick plates.
strengths: Crush Control applies under half a pound of pressure automatically, so thick-cut artisan bread doesn't get flattened
Adjustable temperature dial dials in a slower melt for thick cheese without burning the crust
Feels and performs closer to a countertop appliance built for daily use over years
limitations: Larger and heavier than the other presses in this list
Overkill if grilled cheese is the only thing you'll press

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
